title: 2020 01590 HYB
outcome: No substantive response. One reply (28 September 2026, working day 25) asked for a Council reference.

messages.summary: Request for the Council's records on planning application 2020/01590/HYB (Land South of Llandough Hill and Penarth Road): the ownership certificate, statutory notices, who was served, and ownership documents supplied by the applicant, with notice of an ownership concern.
No response by the 20th working day (21 September 2026). Chaser and formal internal review request.
First reply from the Council, on working day 25: asks for the Council's own reference (prefix 002) before it will look into the delay.
